notes: One entry per candidate publication. 'role' is this research's recommendation, not a decision: GCPI-001 §19 Q1/Q2 are settled in #90. A field marked 'unverified' was not confirmed from the source itself.

sources.series: Commercial Crops: Farmgate Prices, Copra Resecada and Copra Corriente, national, by region and province, monthly
sources.access_detail: PXWeb JSON API, no key. The OpenSTAT web pages return 403 to automated clients; the API does not.
sources.typical_delay: about 2 months (table updated 2026-08-28 with data to 2026-06)
sources.grade: Resecada (dried, milling) and Corriente (higher moisture), reported separately

licence.terms: not stated on the API; OpenSTAT site returned 403 to automated fetch (unverified)

outages_and_changes: Corriente priced above Resecada in 15 months, all in 2024-2026 and none in 2010-2023
Series breaks from 2024-01: r vs ICC's Philippine price +0.91 in 2010-2023, +0.37 since; 8 of 30 months since would be quarantined under GCPI-001 §7.3 (#88, gcpi/BACKTEST.md)
sources.reason: Only primary, machine-readable, long-history copra series found for an export-linked market, with grade stated. Monthly and lagged, so it caps GCPI cadence at monthly if used as the anchor.
before_v1: PSA explains or corrects the series break from 2024-01: correlation with ICC's Philippine price falls from +0.91 (2010-2023) to +0.37 (#88)
Confirm in writing that PSA permits republication of the series

sources.series: Copra farmgate and millgate price monitoring (daily per news reports; national average)
sources.access_detail: Site answers every non-browser client with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403, cf-mitigated: challenge). No published price page or file was found; figures reach the public through press reports.
outages_and_changes: PCA sought powers in July 2026 to influence copra prices (press): a publisher that may also intervene in the market it reports
sources.reason: No retrievable publication: automated access is blocked and no price series is published on the site. Revisit if PCA publishes a machine-readable or signed feed (#89).

sources.series: Weekly Price Update: copra domestic prices per country, converted to US$/MT by ICC
sources.access_detail: Current table as HTML; history as one PDF per month: https://coconutcommunity.org/storage/files/document/wpuYYYY-MM.pdf (all 130 months 2016-01..2026-10 present)

history.gaps: Philippines 26 and Sri Lanka 28 'no quote' weeks of 548; India absent 2019-2021 under the Kochi label (covered by a Kerala label)

sources.basis: domestic (Philippines: Quezon; India: Kochi; Indonesia: industry use; Sri Lanka: unspecified)
sources.currency: USD (converted by ICC from local currency at an undisclosed rate)

licence.terms: © All Rights Reserved by International Coconut Community; no data-use terms published

outages_and_changes: Indonesia series renamed twice: Domestic, North Sulawesi (to 2022-02) -> Domestic (2022-03..2025-10) -> Domestic, Industry Use (from 2025-11)
India series switches label: Kochi (2016-2018, 2022-) and Kerala (2018-2022)
No export-basis (FOB/CIF) copra quote in any month 2016-2026
Reports 2016-10..2017-02 write header dates month-first (MM/DD/YYYY); all others day-first (#88)
wpu2026-01.pdf holds the August 2026 report, so January 2026 is missing from the archive (#88)
sources.reason: Best multi-country weekly history, and the only Indonesian copra price found. Unusable as a live input: secondary (it republishes PCA/UCAP, CDA and CDB), USD conversion undisclosed, series breaks, and all rights reserved, which breaks GCPI-001 §12.3 reproducibility unless ICC grants redistribution.

sources.publisher: Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) and provincial estate-crop offices
sources.series: Statistik Harga Produsen Pertanian, Tanaman Perkebunan Rakyat (annual publication of monthly rural producer prices by province)
sources.access_detail: Annual PDF; copra (kopra) presence in its tables not confirmed. No Ministry of Trade or provincial copra price series was found.
sources.cadence: annual publication of monthly data (unverified for copra)
sources.reason: No primary Indonesian copra price with useful cadence was found. The BPS annual is at best a once-a-year history source; confirming copra in it is Phase 2 work. Indonesia's only current copra price is ICC's survey.

sources.publisher: Coconut Development Board (CDB), Government of India
sources.series: Milling copra market price, Rs/quintal, by market (Kochi, Alappuzha, Kozhikode, Kangayam, ...): daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual views
sources.access_detail: ASP.NET postback form, no API; latest values also at https://coconutboard.in/PriceAppScroll/commodity.aspx
sources.typical_delay: same day to a few days

history.gaps: no prices 2020-03-23..2020-05-31 (COVID lockdown, stated on the page); Kangayam short months in 2024-2025

sources.grade: milling copra (ball copra and Rasi copra reported separately)
sources.basis: wholesale market (spot); Kochi price historically announced by the Cochin Oil Merchants' Association

licence.terms: content owned by CDB; no licence or reuse terms stated

outages_and_changes: Daily view fills every calendar day including Sundays; 50 of 61 Kochi values in Aug-Sep 2026 equal the previous day, so a daily value does not show that a trade or quote happened (GCPI-001 §8.2 freshness)
Form years go back to 1980 but no data is returned before 2008
sources.reason: Primary, grade-specific, long monthly history. India's domestic market does not co-move with the export-linked markets (r = -0.01 with the Philippines on ICC data), so it belongs in a per-country sub-index, not the headline.
before_v1: Confirm in writing that CDB permits republication of the series
Use weekly or monthly values: the daily view carries values forward

sources.publisher: Directorate of Marketing and Inspection, Ministry of Agriculture (AGMARKNET), via data.gov.in
sources.series: Daily mandi prices (min, max, modal) and arrivals, including copra in Kerala markets
sources.access_detail: data.gov.in API (resource 9ef84268-d588-465a-a308-a864a43d0070) returns the current day only; history only through the AGMARKNET portal. No copra rows on 2026-10-18 (Sunday); copra presence confirmed only through a third-party aggregator.

licence.terms: Government Open Data License - India, as stated on the dataset page

outages_and_changes: Full-day API paging timed out on 2026-10-18
sources.reason: Open licence and arrival volumes are valuable, but copra coverage, grade and history are unmeasured. Corroborates the CDB sub-index; Phase 2 should measure its copra history.

sources.series: Daily Price Bulletin, Coconut Products: copra Rs/250 kg (range), with Traded/Nominal flag and the day's US$ rate
sources.access_detail: One PDF per business day under /web/images/pdf/MARKET_DETAILS/YYYY/MON/; file names vary (.xlsx_web.pdf, .xlsx_WEB.pdf, .pdf_s.pdf)

history.start: 2026-01 (only the current year is linked; no earlier bulletin found at the URL pattern or in the Wayback Machine)

outages_and_changes: Bulletin also republishes an Oil World CIF Rotterdam coconut oil quote, a licensed third-party price
sources.reason: Primary and daily, with an explicit traded/nominal flag, which is exactly the freshness signal CDB lacks. Short linked history (current year) means Sri Lanka's backtest must lean on ICC until CDA archives are obtained. Sri Lanka does not co-move with the export-linked markets (r = -0.04 with the Philippines).
before_v1: Confirm in writing that CDA permits republication of the series
Obtain bulletins before 2026 for the backtest

sources.series: Colombo fresh coconut auction: offered and sold quantity, average price Rs/1000 nuts, weekly
sources.access_detail: HTML table for the current year
sources.reason: Fresh nuts, excluded by GCPI-001 §2.2. A genuine auction with volumes, so worth keeping as a supplementary indicator.

sources.publisher: Kokonas Indastri Korporesen (KIK), Papua New Guinea
sources.series: Quarterly Coconut Industry Market Report: domestic copra prices by grade (hot air, FMS, smoke) in kina per tonne, plus 'world' copra prices
sources.access_detail: Quarterly PDFs at unpredictable storage URLs (kik.com.pg/storage/pdfs/<random>.pdf)
sources.grade: hot air, FMS (fair merchantable sundried), smoke
outages_and_changes: World copra price in the report is secondhand, source not named
sources.reason: Quarterly, with no stable URL and no reachable report newer than 2024-Q3. Expansion candidate only.
sources.evidence: KIK Q3 2024 and Q2 market report PDFs

sources.publisher: Commodities Export Marketing Authority (CEMA) and Central Bank of Solomon Islands (CBSI)
sources.series: Quarterly copra export volume and average export price (CEMA); CBSI monthly bulletins (copra price coverage not confirmed)
sources.reason: Quarterly export unit values, not price quotations. Expansion candidate only.
sources.evidence: web search 2026-10-18 (CEMA Q1 2025: US$856/t average export price)

sources.series: Quarterly Statistical Indicators: copra export volume, value and average export price; producer price changes
sources.access_detail: Quarterly PDF; Excel tables published irregularly
sources.reason: Quarterly, and the page reports changes rather than levels. Expansion candidate only.

sources.publisher: World Bank, Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet history)
sources.series: CMO Historical Data Monthly: Coconut oil, US$/mt
sources.access_detail: CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx linked from the page; the file URL changes each year
sources.commodity: coconut oil; copra (Philippines/Indonesia, CIF N.W. Europe) 1960-2014 in archived editions only
sources.basis: CFR Europe from 2025-01; CIF Rotterdam 2021-01..2024-12; CIF NW Europe 1999-2020; c.i.f. Rotterdam before

licence.terms: World Bank data terms; licence for this file not confirmed (unverified)

outages_and_changes: Copra published 1960-2014; the 2020 edition revises 1999-2014 by -14% to +10% and marks 2015 onward '..'; the 2021 edition drops the column (#88)
Coconut oil delivery basis changed four times
sources.reason: Coconut oil is excluded from the index by GCPI-001 §2.2 but is the natural export-market corroboration signal for §7.5. No public export-basis copra quote remains anywhere.

sources.publisher: FAO, FAOSTAT Crops and livestock products (QCL)
sources.series: Production quantity: Coconuts, in shell (item 249) and Coconut oil (item 252), by country, annual
sources.access_detail: Bulk CSV: https://bulks-faostat.fao.org/production/Production_Crops_Livestock_E_All_Data_(Normalized).zip (the JSON API returned HTTP 521 on 2026-10-18)
sources.typical_delay: 1-2 years (coconut oil to 2023, coconuts to 2024 in the 2025-12-31 file)

history.gaps: none at country level for the main producers

sources.commodity: coconut oil and coconuts (no copra item)

licence.terms: CC BY 4.0 with prescribed attribution; datasets may not be used to promote a commercial enterprise

outages_and_changes: Copra is not an item in QCL
sources.reason: The only open, global production dataset. It has no copra item, so §4 weights need coconut oil production plus a documented extraction-rate conversion (GCPI-001 §4.1 forbids an undocumented substitution). 2023 coconut oil shares: Philippines 38.8%, Indonesia 20.7%, India 17.6%, Sri Lanka 1.4%.
sources.evidence: FAOSTAT QCL bulk file, last modified 2025-12-31

sources.series: Coconut Statistical Yearbook: copra production by country; monthly average copra prices

licence.terms: © All Rights Reserved by International Coconut Community

sources.reason: Has copra production directly, which FAOSTAT lacks, but all rights reserved. Usable for weights only if ICC grants redistribution; otherwise a cross-check of the FAOSTAT conversion.

sources.series: Copra and coconut oil CIF Rotterdam quotations
sources.reason: Paid and not redistributable, so it cannot be an input to a reproducible public index (GCPI-001 §12.3). Recorded because CDA republishes its coconut oil quote and it is the likely origin of public CIF Rotterdam figures.
sources.evidence: CDA daily bulletin 2026-10-15 cites 'Source - Oil World'

sources.access_detail: No active copra futures contract found on any exchange
sources.reason: No traded copra contract found. Absence is itself a finding: copra has no exchange price to anchor to.
